text:
- Zoom: documentation/design.md now has two independent axes. Structural levels run from L-1 (project) to L4 (raw record). Text granularities are title, abstract, summary and full, and they apply to every node, including the top. Each is a hash-keyed artifact under sessions/<id>/text/.
- pele (obsidianmd/pele, MIT, npm 1.13.0) has a synchronous render() that returns SVG. The design uses it in a shared markdown-it plugin for VitePress and Slidev, and the UI draws the flow graph from a committed graph.mmd.
- gh confirmed bar9/yolo-twice is public. The install line `claude plugin install yolo-twice --marketplace bar9/yolo-twice` was checked against the CLI help.
- readme.md is renamed to README.md and rewritten. It has a status banner, two mermaid diagrams and a "standing on shoulders" table crediting Claudescope, claude-code-history-viewer, cc_transcript_viewer, claude-code-transcripts, ccusage and pele.
- Nothing is committed. license.txt still has the template placeholder.
